summary: TrackMyRMC Phase 3 (Assign & Dispatch) — backend fully verified end-to-end; customer frontend works end-to-end; owner frontend BLOCKED by a click/navigation regression on the Owner Orders list (order-card taps do not navigate to /order/{id}). Backend: 11 passed, 1 skipped (skip only because seed has only 2 available vehicles and prior tests consumed them; guard is still logically covered — see notes) in /app/backend/tests/test_dispatch_workflow.py. Covers: GET /api/owner/fleet returns 3 vehicles including TS09UB1234/5678/9012 (9012 status=maintenance); GET /api/owner/drivers returns 'Suresh Driver' +919000000002. Full happy path RMC-xxxx PENDING -> approve -> assign-tm (TM_ASSIGNED) -> assign-driver (DRIVER_ASSIGNED + driver_trip created) -> POST challan (CH-xxxx + READY_TO_DISPATCH) -> POST dispatch (DISPATCHED). Customer detail after dispatch exposes tm_number, driver_name='Suresh Driver', driver_mobile=+919000000002, challan_number=CH-xxxx and 6-step history (PENDING/ACCEPTED/TM_ASSIGNED/DRIVER_ASSIGNED/READY_TO_DISPATCH/DISPATCHED). GET /customer/orders/{id}/challan and /owner/orders/{id}/challan return same challan; both 404 before generation. State guards: dispatch-before-challan => 409, assign-driver-before-tm => 409, assign-maintenance-vehicle (TS09UB9012) => 409. Isolation: foreign vehicle_id (random ObjectId) on assign-tm => 404. RBAC: customer token on every /owner/* dispatch endpoint (fleet/drivers/assign-tm/assign-driver/challan/dispatch) => 403. Frontend (Expo web 390x844): Customer login (+919000000001) succeeds via dev_otp; Orders tab lists 14 orders; opening a DISPATCHED order shows Transit Mixer + Driver rows, the 'transit mixer is on the way' tracking note, order-call-driver + order-view-challan buttons; tapping View Challan navigates to /challan/{id} showing 'TRACK MY RMC · Delivery Challan · CH-2002' with plant/customer/site/grade/qty/TM/driver + working Share button. OWNER FRONTEND REGRESSION: owner login (owner@trackmyrmc.test) reaches /orders with 2 PENDING cards visible, but tapping the order-card testID does NOT navigate to /order/{id} — URL stays at /orders (tried element click + mouse click at safe coordinates well above the tab bar). Because the detail screen doesn't open, none of the OwnerDispatchPanel UI (assign-tm-*, assign-driver-*, generate-challan, dispatch-order, view-challan) can be exercised via the owner UI. Backend fully validates every step, so this is purely a click/navigation regression on the owner orders list.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping an order-card-RMC-xxxx on the owner /orders tab does not navigate to /order/{id}. The card is fully in the viewport (bbox y=497..661, viewport 844, tab bar at bottom ~780+) and the same OrderCard testID click works for customer, so this appears specific to the owner orders screen wiring. Suspect an outer Pressable/ScrollView on the owner Orders route absorbing the press, or the card's onPress not wired for the owner variant. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(owner)/orders.tsx (or wherever the owner orders list renders OrderCard) — verify that <OrderCard onPress={...} testID={`order-card-${o.order_number}`} /> pushes to `/order/${o.id}` and that no parent view has pointerEvents='none' or intercepts taps.

integration_issues.issue: Because owner order-card click does not navigate, the entire assign-TM -> assign-driver -> generate-challan -> dispatch UI in OwnerDispatchPanel could not be exercised via the frontend. Backend chain is 100% verified via pytest.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings still present. Non-blocking. Reference: multiple screens.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Owner Orders tab — order-card taps must navigate to /order/{id}. Verify /app/frontend/app/(owner)/orders.tsx (or equivalent) passes onPress -> router.push(`/order/${o.id}`) to OrderCard, that testID='order-card-${order_number}' is set on the Pressable/TouchableOpacity itself (not on a non-pressable parent wrapper), and that no parent has pointerEvents='none' / an overlay blocking taps. Customer side works, so diff the two lists to find the divergence.

AFTER FIX: Re-run owner UI E2E: /orders -> tap PENDING card -> Approve -> select TS09UB1234 (assign-tm) -> select Suresh Driver -> Generate Challan -> Dispatch -> View Challan (share button). Verify progress checklist ticks (Transit Mixer / Driver / Challan / Dispatched) update after each step.
(Optional) Silence deprecated 'shadow*' / props.pointerEvents warnings by migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: owner.py assign_tm allows the guard order.status in (ACCEPTED, SCHEDULED, PRODUCTION_COMPLETE, TM_ASSIGNED) — TM_ASSIGNED is allowed for idempotent re-selection; correct.
owner.py generate_challan is idempotent (returns existing challan if present) — good; matched by pytest.
owner.py dispatch_order transitions vehicle.status='dispatched' and driver_trip.status='DISPATCHED' atomically — verified.
Plant isolation: assign_tm queries vehicles by {_id, plant_id: order.plant_id} — so a vehicle in a different plant returns 404. Verified via pytest with a random ObjectId.
Challan number uses next_sequence('challan_number') with prefix CH-2000+seq — verified CH-2001..CH-2002 across two dispatches with no collision.
OwnerDispatchPanel gates UI transitions by exact status match (needTm/needDriver/needChallan/needDispatch) matching backend state machine — consistent.
seed.py seeds 3 vehicles only under plants[0] (Kondapur). Drivers list is scoped by plant_id so only that plant will see Suresh — consistent with the spec.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 executed passed; 1 skip due to vehicle scarcity — non-defect)
success_rate.frontend: Customer 100%; Owner 0% of dispatch UI executable (blocked by card-tap navigation regression on owner /orders)

seed_data_creation: None — reused dev seed. pytest created several TEST_ prefixed customer orders on the Kondapur plant that walked to DISPATCHED (RMC-1005 etc.), and consumed the 2 available TMs. If the main agent re-runs the owner UI flow, re-seed vehicles or run backend seed to reset TM status back to 'available' — otherwise the OwnerDispatchPanel will show only the maintenance vehicle (which is correctly non-tappable).

rca_of_issue: Owner order-card navigation regression — Reproduction: 1) log in as owner@trackmyrmc.test, 2) go to Orders tab, 3) tap any order-card-RMC-xxxx. Expected: URL becomes /order/{id} and detail screen renders. Actual: URL remains /orders, no navigation. The customer Orders tab does navigate correctly with the same OrderCard testID prefix, so the defect is in the owner-side list wiring (missing onPress prop, wrong parent absorbing taps, or an intermediate wrapper with pointerEvents='none'). Recommend diffing the owner orders list JSX vs the customer orders list JSX and inspecting the immediate parent of OrderCard. Not a backend issue — the entire dispatch chain works via curl/pytest.
